description: This file contains shell functions for checking and performing upgrades on devices using RedBoot FIS images, including verification of image format and the upgrade process involving tar extraction and MTD commands.

methods.name: platform_check_image_redboot_fis
methods.description: Checks if the provided image has the correct magic word indicating a valid RedBoot FIS image.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_redboot_fis
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process for RedBoot FIS images, handling different partition update methods depending on the image content.
